definitions.gloss: brown sugar; unrefined sugar; raw sugar
definitions.explanation: Dark, unrefined cane sugar with a rich, molasses-like flavor. A specialty product of Okinawa and other southern Japanese islands.

examples.japanese: ⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黒砂糖|くろざとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧おいしい。
{黒砂糖|くろざとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: Sweets made with brown sugar are popular.

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{白砂糖|しろざとう}→白砂糖：26404_shirozatou⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{黒砂糖|くろざとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦コク→コク：20672_koku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you put brown sugar instead of white sugar in your coffee, it gives it a richer flavor.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧ (black/dark) + ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧ (sugar). Also shortened to ⟦{黒糖|こくとう}→黒糖：19618_kokutou⟧. Okinawan {黒砂糖|くろざとう} is a well-known regional product and is used in many traditional sweets and drinks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黒砂糖|くろざとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use brown sugar)
- ⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧{産|さん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黒砂糖|くろざとう} (Okinawan brown sugar)
- {黒砂糖|くろざとう}⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧ (brown sugar flavor)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{白砂糖|しろざとう}→白砂糖：26404_shirozatou⟧: white sugar — refined sugar
- ⟦{黒糖|こくとう}→黒糖：19618_kokutou⟧: brown sugar — a shorter, more common alternative name
- ⟦{角砂糖|かくざとう}→角砂糖：18293_kakuzatou⟧: sugar cube — a different form of sugar
